stage.name: EI-seed-unit
stage.source: twodist.ei_H() unit edges (the seed's unit part; cheats are NOT edges here)

claim_scope: per pair: forced-additively (every listed hom identifies it — THEORY-LEVEL), separated-additively (the cited colouring, listed here and verified proper, separates it — a certificate), not-comparable (different components), vacuous (no hom). A row reading forced-additively says every ADDITIVE colouring of this chunk gives the pair one colour; it does NOT say every colouring does — the fabric's valuation-4 pairs are the standing counterexample (forced-additively, separated by the solver). A row reading separated-additively or kempe-separated comes with an explicit proper colouring in the same file, verified; it IS a certificate that the pair is not forced. vacuous means no additive colouring exists and says nothing about χ.
